title.en: Kizuna no Seijou wa Shinjitai - Mukosei no Seijo wa Henkyou no Machi kara Nariagaru
Inchiki Seijo to Iwareta no de, Kuni wo Dete Nonbiri Kurasou to Omoimasu
Watashi, Seijo. Ima, Kankinsarete Iru no
Denka, Anata ga Suteta Onna ga Honmono no Seijo desu
Saijoukyuu no Seijorashii desu ga, Ryuuou-sama no Hanayome ni wa narimasen! - Tsuihousareta no de Kusushi to shite Daini no Jinsei wo Oukashimasu
Tsuihou Joutou! Tensai Seijo no Watakushi wa, Doko de Darou to Kagayakemasu no de.
Honmono no Seijo Janai to Bareta no ni, Outei Denka ni Semararete imasu
Nise Seijo da to Ikenie ni Saretara, Maou-sama ni Kyuukonsaremashita
Nise Seijo!? Mira no Boukentan - Tsuihousaremashita ga, Jitsu wa Saikyou na no de Second Life wo Tanoshimimasu!
Imouto no Migawari de Totsuida Hazu ga, Douyara Watashi ga Shin no Seijo Datta you desu
Ikenie to shite Surerareta no de, Henkyou Hakke ni Jibun wo Urimasu
Kon'yakusha no Uwaki Genba o Michatta no de Hajimari no Kane ga Narimashita
Seijo-sama wo Osagashi de Shitara Imouto de Machigai Arimasen. Saa Douzo Otsure kudasai, Imasugu.
Seijo no Ane desu ga, Naze ka Miwaku no Koushaku-sama ni Tsukaeru Koto ni narimashita
Heibon na Watashi no Juukishidan Mofumofu Life

title.ja-ro: Kanpeki Sugite Kawaige ga Nai to Kon'yaku Haki Sareta Seijo wa Ringoku ni Urareru
